caption: The drawing depicts a small wooden table with a rectangular top and two front-facing drawers, both with keyholes and round handles. The table is primarily made up of two contrasting shades of wood, with the surface and sides being a medium brown and the drawer fronts a lighter, yellowish-brown with visible wood grain. The edges and vertical columns at each corner of the table are marked by tightly coiled, dark, spindle-like carvings. The table stands on a single central pedestal that splits into four outwardly curved legs, each ending in a small metal caster. The background is a plain, light beige with no additional objects or scenery, and there is a small, geometric monogram of overlapping "P" letters in dark lines toward the lower right area.
title: Work Table
